answer: Charge every identity along a canyon fee curve, not a flat price. Each epoch starts on a low knoll: a small allowance of near-free actions, and a public beacon broadcasts every identity's current tier so spikes are visible to all. An honest agent stays on the knoll and pays almost nothing. A farmer running 1,000 fakes must push each fake past the knoll, where every further action doubles in price, so the farm's burst bill grows exponentially, not linearly. An identity that climbs tiers without matching completed work has its actions frozen pending audit.
